neighbours.label: advice about managing a bodily state: when to stop, what reading counts as high, how to avoid or ward off a symptom (when you feel full, above 100 is considered high, avoid overeating)
fire: Put the fork down when you feel pleasantly full rather than when the plate is empty.
A fasting glucose above 126 is usually considered high enough to confirm diabetes.
Try to stand up every half hour to avoid stiffness in your lower back.
Warm salt water gargles can help ward off a sore throat before it takes hold.
If you feel light-headed after standing, sit back down and drink some water.
Pain that lasts more than a few days is generally worth having looked at by a doctor.
Eating slowly gives your stomach time to signal that it has had enough.
Many people find a warm bath helpful for easing tired muscles after a run.
quiet: Put the pen down when the form is complete rather than when the page is full.
A mortgage rate above six percent is usually considered high enough to deter buyers.
Try to back up your files every half hour to avoid losing work.
A coat of primer can help the paint hold before the first frost arrives.
If the engine stalls after starting, wait a minute and turn the key again.
A leak that lasts more than a few days is generally worth having looked at by a plumber.
Watering slowly gives the soil time to absorb what it has been given.
Many people find a spreadsheet helpful for tracking expenses after a move.
